query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01') WHERE h IN ('1cfcfe58e3462df9a3ab474a66536ef48f5acc2c1e7ad2abb294446a', '26c0f8e2d3be37de297fa57c48820fcb24c7b09aebe280430cef9d87', '3333c8022c24d2014f02236c082105ebceb73c46c45f94eb99136f92', '46e607b3046a34c95e7c29e47047618dbf5e10de777ba56c590cfd5c', '7c7487bca5af9814f10b9e8239b9efa46f20f87edd075f78d62abbb7', 'b8193d5acd8a0a6aa1f06ed1835648bc76e458c6c4621c543b769a3e', 'be670fd506fe343c238b8c3357511b863c8c2173f49a0b56aba1ab24', 'bf5ba087d428e870a809c3e88fa8de019e01f5f31582c0e4abcb42bd', 'db7245ff4fe23633e2c10ef62374ca6b64efd80d31fc3f7c431386e0', 'fd4572b20a1d76e7dc0aaa548579bacc2b318a4862a7e12f94b7e76d')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
